# stacklet_datadog_integration (Data Source)

Retrieve the Datadog integration.

The integration applies to the whole deployment, so this takes no arguments. The credentials are never returned by the API; `configured` reports whether it holds them.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "stacklet_datadog_integration" "example" {}

output "datadog_ready" {
  description = "Whether credentials are held and every execution region that has reported holds the current configuration."
  value       = data.stacklet_datadog_integration.example.configured && data.stacklet_datadog_integration.example.status.status == "SUCCESS"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `configured` (Boolean) Whether the API holds credentials.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether policies may use the `datadog-metrics` filter.
- `id` (String) A fixed identifier for the integration, which is global and has no ID of its own.
- `site` (String) The Datadog site the credentials belong to, as a bare hostname, e.g. `datadoghq.com`.
- `status` (Attributes) Status of the background operations that put this configuration in force, and their rolled-up summary. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status))

<a id="nestedatt--status"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status`

Read-Only:

- `details` (Attributes List) One entry per operation. An operation with nothing to report — never run, and nothing underway — has no entry. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status--details))
- `status` (String) Rolled up across the details: `ERROR` if every operation that reached an outcome failed, `PARTIAL_SUCCESS` if successes mix with failures or with operations still outstanding, `SUCCESS` if every operation that reached an outcome succeeded, and `SKIPPED` when there is no outcome anywhere yet. An operation still waiting on its first outcome keeps the summary off `SUCCESS` but never counts as a failure.

<a id="nestedatt--status--details"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status.details`

Read-Only:

- `at` (String) When that attempt finished; null whenever `status` is, and when `status` is `UNAVAILABLE`.
- `component` (String) What the entry describes: `<region>-secret`, e.g. `us-east-1-secret`, is whether Secrets Manager holds the credentials in that region, which it replicates on its own schedule; `<region>-execution` is whether the region has recorded where to find them, so a policy running there can use them. Every region the configuration is meant to reach has both from the moment that is decided, so the list doesn't grow as propagation lands.
- `message` (String) A human-readable summary of that attempt, typically why it failed. May be set alongside a null `status`, to say what is being waited on.
- `running_since` (String) Set while an attempt is underway, whether or not one has completed before; the other fields go on describing the last completed attempt.
- `status` (String) Outcome of the most recent completed attempt; null when none has completed. Not a state: `running_since` says whether an attempt is underway.
